digest.component_or_area: application-wide configuration and authentication composition system (RP-04 epic)
propositions: Configuration and authentication are resolved inconsistently across multiple operation boundaries, potentially changing behavior mid-operation, discarding explicit choices, or exposing credentials to unrelated children.

Rebar must establish one immutable, serializable OperationSnapshot resolved once per operation boundary with explicit precedence: explicit input > environment > project config > user config > schema default.

Provider-native authentication must be injected only through the existing RP-01 ProviderSession path while preserving budget, retry history, cache/accounting, exhaustion, artifacts, tracing, usage, and failure behavior.

Credentials and secrets must not appear in repr, equality/hash, serialization, snapshots, logs, exceptions, argv, subprocess environment, or any CLI/MCP schema, and same-capability children must inherit ambient environment while unrelated siblings lose Rebar-declared secret names.

Op-cert must accept exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY, validate before queue/worker creation, copy the key into a process-owned 0700 directory, and receive context-local signer/principal bindings without runtime SSM/boto3 coupling.

An AST ownership gate must derive config/credential names from authoritative registries, reject direct and aliased config reads below approved seams, permit only exact path/symbol+rationale exceptions, and reach zero legacy exceptions at cutover.
